note: Fees include the international exchange contribution. Since 1 May 2025 every adult of 18 or more may get a ten-year passport, those who haven't done military service included. Read from Suwon's fee page (updated 2026-02-27, an official e-government site). Suwon's page on collecting a passport gives 8 working days from application to collection in Korea where the identity check raises nothing, taken as the route's time.
